_note: Two-digit substitution of D 4 113/9 fol. 17 (18 Nov 1643), rebuilt 14 Nov 2026 from this letter alone: the '#' margin summaries give the sense, and the groups follow it letter for letter (und erheblichen, persönlich, communiciren). Homophones: t = 8+, 32; m = 22, 24. 'Z|' is a code sign, probably Landgraf Johann (the margin summary). Values not seen in this letter are not filled.
